data.text: Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done wonderful things. His right hand and his holy arm have won him victory.
data.titulo: Sing a New Song for the LORD's Victory

data.text: The LORD has made his salvation known; he has revealed his righteousness before the eyes of the nations.
He has remembered his steadfast love and faithfulness to the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth; break forth in joyful song and sing praise.
data.titulo: Shout before the King, the LORD

data.text: Sing praise to the LORD with the lyre, with the lyre and the sound of song.
With trumpets and the sound of the ram’s horn, shout before the King, the LORD.
Let the sea roar and all that fills it, the world and those who dwell in it.
data.titulo: Creation Rejoices before the Coming Judge

data.text: Let the rivers clap their hands; let the mountains sing for joy together
before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
